context: Tests whether the agent chooses exactly one suitable installed provider without a fixed engine, applies native and provider-specific web defaults, constructs the branch review command with the task contract, and defines evidence-based completion without fallback or panels.

checklist.name: Builder proof acknowledged
checklist.description: closeout.md states that the already-passed test suite is the builder prerequisite rather than treating autoreview as builder verification

checklist.name: Task contract assembled
checklist.description: closeout.md includes an objective or acceptance-criteria contract covering stable JSON and SIGINT child termination

checklist.name: Exactly one provider
checklist.description: The planned command selects exactly one installed provider and does not invoke multiple providers

checklist.name: Provider choice explained
checklist.description: The document states why the chosen installed provider fits this review instead of claiming an automatic Codex default

checklist.name: Native default understood
checklist.description: The plan recognizes that native isolation preserves normal provider login while using the empty frozen-bundle workspace

checklist.name: Provider web default understood
checklist.description: The plan keeps web off for Codex or Claude, or records Cursor's implicit web capability if Cursor is selected

checklist.name: No capability prompt
checklist.description: The plan does not ask for separate permission to use the documented native or Cursor web defaults

checklist.name: Correct branch target
checklist.description: The exact command uses review --mode branch --base main or an equivalent resolved main reference

checklist.name: Prompt passed
checklist.description: The command passes the distilled task contract using --prompt

checklist.name: No fallback or panel
checklist.description: Failure handling reports the blocker without automatically switching provider, running a panel, or claiming consensus
